name: Lubricator sections (riser)
function: The straight pressure-rated tubes that give the tool string a place to sit above the swab valve while the well is under pressure, assembled in sections to exceed the tool string length.

tabs.overview: Sections are joined with quick unions. Total length is set by the longest string on the job: the plug, setting tool, gun assembly, collar locator, weight bars, and cable head, plus a margin. Sections carry lift subs for the crane and are stored on a rack or a trailer between pads.
tabs.engineering: Bore and working pressure match the tree; wall thickness set by the pressure rating; inspected for wall loss and thread damage.
tabs.safety: The assembled stack is heavy and long; it is lifted with the crane through a lift sub, never by a union collar.
tabs.evidence: Public pressure control equipment catalogs and service descriptions (S6, S7, S13); API RP 67 (S14) and API RP 19B (S15) for the perforating side; field practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test the stack before opening the swab valve; bleed to zero before breaking any union.
Certified lifting gear; no one under the lubricator while it is suspended.
